        PATTERN E(cgr:"Create Purchase Order")-[]-O(quot:"quotation")-[]-O(pr:"purchase_requisition")
        SUBJECTTO count(PATTERN O(pr)-[]-E(cpr:"Create Purchase Requisition")
                        RETURN cpr AS cpr
        ) == 0 
        RETURN cgr AS cgr, 
               quot AS quot, 
               pr AS pr,
               apo AS apo
